thread.title: Girls und Panzer - Operation: More Love Love! • Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the comedy, fanservice, and heartwarming moments enjoyable.
The episode was viewed as entertaining and well-balanced between comedic segments and the series' broader lore.
One commenter felt some recurring jokes, especially a particular team gag, were becoming worn out, though the episode handled that material effectively.
A viewer rated the episode as merely okay and was more excited for future tank-battle material.
The show's current rhythm and overall direction were praised, with interest in seeing more.
